name: shadcn/ui
summary: Copy-in components wired on Radix primitives and Tailwind: the component layer here is shadcn-style, and the two dashboard starters are built on it.

cli: npx shadcn@latest add button card dialog input tabs
steps: Set up the two prerequisites first: the tailwind entry (v4) and the react entry. shadcn does not work without both.

Run npx shadcn@latest init. It detects the framework, writes components.json and lib/utils.ts, installs the clsx/tailwind-merge/radix dependencies, and emits the theme CSS. The files below are what init produces, so you can write them yourself when the CLI is not available.

Add components with npx shadcn@latest add <name> (drops a component into components/ui). For the 109 richer shadcn-style components vendored here, use design_kit_search (kit: "gradientdeck") instead, then design_kit_code for the full variant source.
Dev dependency for animations in v4: npm install -D tw-animate-css (the theme CSS imports it).

files.role: shadcn registry config: where components land and how aliases resolve
The cn() class-merge helper every shadcn component imports
Tailwind v4 entry with the vendored shadcn neutral theme (cssVars pinned in frontend/vendor/theme.json)

notes: The vendored flavor in frontend/vendor/ is the radix-vega style, pinned by sha256: its style.json declares dependencies cn, class-variance-authority, lucide-react, and the consolidated radix-ui package, with tw-animate-css and shadcn as dev dependencies. That flavor's lib/utils.ts is just `export { cn } from "cn"`, so it uses the cn package instead of clsx plus tailwind-merge. Either flavor works: match the dependency list to whichever utils.ts you ship. The registry JSON for its 11 components (button, card, dialog, tabs, tooltip, dropdown-menu, accordion, input, badge, and the style record) sits beside it for reference. MIT license, vendored copy in frontend/vendor/shadcn-LICENSE.md. For a no-install prototype, the gallery serves compiled shadcn modules: design_assets (view: "importmap") maps the shadcn/*, radix-ui, cn, and class-variance-authority specifiers to content-addressed URLs on a running gallery.
